scientific_integrity: The analytical proof supplies the global moment inequality and exact sharpness, with exact symbolic checks as supporting reproducibility. No independent scientific audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Planar linear harmonic oscillator at a single fixed positive frequency; independent exogenous nonnegative time steps with finite mean.
Exact one-step isotropization concerns uncentered second moments (or centered covariance for initially zero-mean ensembles), not the full angular law.
Neither trajectory accuracy at a physical time nor general multi-frequency, nonlinear, noisy or computational-efficiency guarantees are established.
The unique mean-minimizing law permits a zero step; strictly positive steps attain every larger feasible mean but not the infimum.
title: Minimum mean step for one-step second-moment isotropization under random-time implicit midpoint
